about: Floors for the keyword decision eval (run.py --check). Set to the scores measured on 2026-11-10 at 216ae9646 (sensitivity 7/15 = 0.466667 with 6 false negatives, rigor 10/13 = 0.769231 with 2, look 7/10 = 0.7 with 3; accuracies rounded DOWN to 4 places, less than one case), so CI fails when a keyword rule gets WORSE; raise them as the rules (or their replacements) improve, never lower them to make a change pass.
